title: Design System: Wilson's Toolkit — Floating Gallery

title.purpose: Names the active tool beneath its screenshot without competing with the image.

label.purpose: Used for the compact wordmark and OPEN action.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Grounds screenshot cards softly at rest.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Deepens the active screenshot on hover or keyboard focus.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The shared responsive easing for lifts, fades, and navigation state.

motion.name: snap
motion.purpose: Settles the ring precisely on the selected card.

motion.name: desktop-autoplay
motion.purpose: Advances the idle desktop gallery; disabled on mobile and for reduced motion.

motion.name: card-float
motion.purpose: Adds quiet staggered vertical drift to individual cards.

motion.name: drag-inertia
motion.value: velocity × 0.94 per frame, then nearest-card snap
motion.purpose: Preserves horizontal drag momentum before settling.

components.name: Wordmark
components.description: Compact pearl signature fixed at the upper-left of the gallery.
components.css: .ds-wordmark { color: var(--color-text, #f6f6f2); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; line-height: 1; text-decoration: none; } .ds-wordmark:hover { opacity: 0.78; } .ds-wordmark:focus-visible { outline: 0.15rem solid var(--color-focus, #b9d4ff); outline-offset: 0.3rem; }

components.name: Screenshot Card
components.description: A real 16:10 product screenshot with soft depth and a restrained lift state.
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; width: min(36rem, 82vw); aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; border-radius: 1rem; color: inherit; outline-offset: 0.65rem; transition: transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card-image { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 2.6rem 6rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.58); transition: transform 650ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-0.65rem) scale(1.025); } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-image { transform: scale(1.025); box-shadow: 0 3.2rem 7.5rem rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.72); } .ds-card:focus-visible { outline: 0.15rem solid var(--color-focus, #b9d4ff); transform: translateY(-0.65rem) scale(1.025); } .ds-card:active { transform: translateY(-0.25rem) scale(0.99); }

components.name: Active Caption
components.description: Transparent active-only tool label with a desktop OPEN affordance.
components.css: .ds-caption { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text, #f6f6f2); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-caption-name { overflow: hidden; font-size: clamp(0.86rem, 1.35vw, 1.05rem); font-weight: 500; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-caption-open { color: var(--color-text, #f6f6f2); font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } @media (max-width: 42rem) { .ds-caption-open { display: none; } }

components.name: Ring Navigation
components.description: Generous button targets containing minimal dots; the current item becomes a pearl pill.
components.html: <nav class="ds-ring-nav" aria-label="選擇工具"><button aria-label="顯示第一個工具" aria-current="true"></button><button aria-label="顯示第二個工具"></button><button aria-label="顯示第三個工具"></button><button aria-label="顯示第四個工具"></button></nav>
components.css: .ds-ring-nav { display: flex; gap: 0.6rem; padding: 0.7rem; } .ds-ring-nav button { width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ring-nav button::before { display: block; width: 0.38rem; height: 0.38rem; margin: auto; border-radius: 50%; background: #555552; content: ""; transition: width 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-ring-nav button[aria-current="true"]::before, .ds-ring-nav button:hover::before, .ds-ring-nav button:focus-visible::before { width: 1.5rem; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--color-text, #f6f6f2); } .ds-ring-nav button:focus-visible { outline: 0.15rem solid var(--color-focus, #b9d4ff); outline-offset: 0.3rem; }

components.name: Skip Link
components.description: Keyboard-only pearl utility that enters the viewport when focused.
components.css: .ds-skip { display: inline-block; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; transform: translateY(-180%); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--color-text, #f6f6f2); color: var(--color-bg, #0a0a0a); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-skip:focus, .ds-skip:focus-visible { transform: translateY(0); outline: 0.15rem solid var(--color-focus, #b9d4ff); outline-offset: 0.3rem; }

narrative.overview: Wilson's Toolkit is presented as a restrained exhibition rather than a conventional directory. A near-black field recedes behind a ring of real product screenshots, allowing visitors to recognize each tool visually before opening it. Pearl typography is deliberately scarce, and the interface avoids descriptive blocks, card codes, visible item counts, and decorative chrome. The signature is a full-viewport 3D ring: one large card faces the viewer while adjacent tools remain dimly visible at the edges. Soft depth, slow floating motion, inertial dragging, and precise snapping make the system spatial without becoming theatrical. This direction is anchored to design seed user-pinned-39b98dd9 and to the first direction contract in index.html.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black and pearl restrained palette with only functional muted and focus colors.
Real 16:10 product screenshots are the dominant content and identity.
Full-screen 3D ring with one active card, visible peripheral cards, and minimal navigation.
Active-only caption on a transparent background; no visible card code or count.
Archivo throughout, with compact weights, sizes, and tracking.
Desktop timed snap, mobile manual control, hover lift, and drag inertia.

rules.name: The Pearl Is Rare Rule
rules.body: Use pearl only for active or essential information; its scarcity creates hierarchy.

rules.name: The Screenshot Owns Color Rule
rules.body: Interface chrome remains neutral so the real tool screenshots supply the scene's color and detail.

rules.name: The Minimum Type Rule
rules.body: If the screenshot or interaction already communicates the information, do not add a visible heading, description, card code, or item count.

rules.name: The Spatial Before Ornamental Rule
rules.body: Express hierarchy through ring position, opacity, scale, and soft elevation; do not add outlines, gradients, glass panels, or decorative borders.

dos: Do keep the near-black field visually quiet so the screenshot remains the first read.
Do use authentic screenshots at 16:10 and preserve their full, recognizable interface.
Do reveal the transparent caption only for the active card.
Do preserve hover lift, keyboard focus, inertial dragging, and snap-to-card behavior.
Do keep desktop autoplay slow and pausable, and disable it on mobile and for reduced motion.
donts: Don't add card codes, visible counts, descriptive paragraphs, category chips, or dashboard-style metadata.
Don't place captions on opaque panels or attach extra chrome to screenshot cards.
Don't introduce accent colors outside authentic screenshots except the functional focus color.
Don't flatten the gallery into a conventional grid or hide all peripheral cards.
Don't autoplay on mobile or override reduced-motion preferences.
